question.text: If the formula of basic Beryllium nitrate is <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> . What is the value of 'n' here

solution.text:
Basic Beryllium nitrate is Be4ONO36
2n−2−6=0
Hence, n=4
